name: MIAU
source:
[url=/c171564]Lucia[/url]’s most recent creation: a robot with cat-like qualities. People wonder what is going on inside her head. The answer? Nyah! This loveable goofball has ultimately become Lucia’s assistant and mascot of her store. She is especially popular with ladies.
